test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Identify the tone of the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is:** 'Rational'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The **tone of a passage **is the **writer’s attitude or feeling about the subject** that he or she is presenting.
 
• The tone of the given passage is** "Rational" **and the meaning of rational is **"based on facts or reason and not on emotions or feelings." **
 
• In the given passage the author is explaining the topic **based on facts **or **reason and not on emotions or feelings** So the tone of the passage is Rational
 
• The rest of the statements in the other options are contextually incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is:** Rational.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Lets see meaning of other options:
 
 
• **Assertive**: expressing your opinion clearly and firmly so that people listen to you or do what you want 
 
• **Satirical**: satirical writing or art uses humour to criticize people or things and make them seem silly
 
• **Scientific:** is used to describe things that relate to science or to a particular science
